notes.setups: the lesson's engagements in order, each from its set-up (docs/ai.md §26)
notes.heading: the player's heading in the set-ups: away from the base
notes.arm: the aggressor's AIM-120 at its wingtips for the BVR shots

notes.time: a day lesson (training-plan.md §1: every lesson but the night lesson and the night check rides by day)
notes.wind_kt: calm (inferred: the fight is learnt without a wind to allow for)
notes.start: the base's parking spot for the unit (modern-iaf/data/airbases, airbases.md §5); the altitude: the terrain's ground there (elevation_m without the terrain)
notes.runway: the base's runway the take-off missions use; the tower turns it into the wind
notes.loadout: an air-to-air load on the jet's allowed stations (data/db/units)
notes.route: steerpoint 1 the drones' area, steerpoint 2 the fight's, at the lesson's height (inferred: training areas about 40 to 90 km from the base, away from towns; the IAF's own areas are not public)
notes.training.time_budget_s: the start-up, the taxi, the flight to the area, the lesson's engagements and the way home with time to spare (inferred)
notes.training.end_hold_s: a fail shows its reason 5 s before the debrief: time to see the result
notes.training.end: the lesson ends with the jet back on its spot and the engine off (training.md §16.3)
notes.failures: none of its own: the check ride's unannounced emergency comes from training.md §13.4
notes.training.checklist: the cards from the start to the shutdown, as check ride 2 (data/checklists, training.md §12)
notes.training.calls: the tower's four ground calls: phase 1's tower_calls item (training.md §3.3)
